name: Progression
coreRules: Level is derived from total XP and is never stored independently in LevelProgression.
ProgressionCurve uses cumulative strictly increasing safe-integer thresholds.
ExperiencePool is cumulative and protects against safe-integer overflow.
UnlockSet stores opaque semantic unlock IDs and does not integrate SkillTreeGraph automatically.
ProgressionSnapshot stores mutable state only; ProgressionCurve is provided externally on restore.
Agent level/experience is not migrated or synchronized automatically.
Stage 58 Narrative expansion is not anticipated.
